name: hergy-webtools
comment: The WebUI's modules' own tools, pinned to exact versions (no ^ or ~): eslint for the names gate (eslint.config.js: every name a module uses is defined or imported, and every name it defines or imports is read), happy-dom for the unit gate (setup.js: the modules' tests run in bun with a document and no browser), and openapi-typescript for the apitypes gate (the screens' API types, made from internal/apicontract/openapi.yaml). go run ./tools/check names / unit / apitypes copy this file, bun.lock and the two scripts into .bin/webtools and install there, since Go would read the .go files one dependency ships. To move a version, edit it here, run bun install here, keep bun.lock and delete node_modules.
